events.subtitle: Electroacoustic saxophone-and-mallet quintet
events.category: Electroacoustic chamber jazz / Saxophone and mallet ensemble
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Ben Wendel's BaRcoDe for six performances from March 21 through March 23, 2027. March 21 and 22 have sets at 16:30 and 19:30, with doors at 15:30 and 18:30; March 23 has sets at 18:00 and 20:30, with doors at 17:00 and 19:45. The announced Tokyo quintet is Wendel on saxophone, Joel Ross on marimba, Simon Moullier on balafon, Patricia Brennan and Warren Wolf on vibraphone. The venue describes an electroacoustic sound built from saxophone, mallet instruments and effects. The music charge is ¥9,900; reserved seating categories bring the verified per-person total as high as ¥15,400. JAM SESSION presale begins November 14 and general web reservations begin November 21, so no live event-specific ticket destination is recorded before those sales open.

en.why_it_matters: The lineup changes the physics of a jazz quintet: Wendel's saxophone and effects have to find space inside four different mallet attacks and resonances, from marimba and balafon to two vibraphones. Ross, Moullier, Brennan and Wolf each bring a distinct rhythmic and harmonic vocabulary, so the draw is the architecture of this exact ensemble rather than an all-star list.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for one set if Tokyo overlaps March 21–23. Six performances provide enough flexibility to fit the project into a stay, so it is not a reason to redesign the trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: La formación cambia la física de un quinteto de jazz: el saxofón y los efectos de Wendel tienen que abrirse paso entre cuatro ataques y resonancias distintas, desde marimba y balafón hasta dos vibráfonos. Ross, Moullier, Brennan y Wolf aportan vocabularios rítmicos y armónicos propios; el atractivo está en la arquitectura de este ensamble exacto, no en una lista de nombres.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a uno de los sets si Tokio coincide entre el 21 y el 23 de marzo. Las seis funciones dan margen para acomodarlo dentro de la estancia, sin rehacer el viaje sólo por esta fecha.

events.subtitle: Special acoustic duo engagement
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Molly Tuttle and Ketch Secor for four duo performances on February 11 and 12, 2027. February 11 has sets at 16:30 and 19:30, with doors at 15:30 and 18:30; February 12 has sets at 18:00 and 20:30, with doors at 17:00 and 19:45. The venue announces only Tuttle on voice and guitar and Secor on voice and fiddle, and describes an ongoing musical partnership spanning recordings and live appearances. Tuttle's official biography independently identifies Secor as her partner and a co-writer and multi-instrumentalist on So Long Little Miss Sunshine. The music charge is ¥8,800; reserved seating categories bring the verified per-person total as high as ¥14,300. JAM SESSION presale begins November 12 and general web reservations begin November 19, so no live event-specific ticket destination is recorded before those sales open.

en.why_it_matters: The duo format removes the safety net: Tuttle's flatpicked guitar has to carry rhythm, harmony and lead detail while Secor's fiddle and second voice answer it in real time. Their shared writing history gives the set a lived musical grammar, making this more specific than pairing two prominent roots musicians for a club date.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for one of the four sets if Tokyo overlaps February 11–12. The intimate duo format is a strong reason to choose the night, while repeated performances and an ongoing collaboration keep it from becoming a trip-defining obligation.

es.why_it_matters: El formato de dúo quita la red de seguridad: la guitarra flatpicked de Tuttle tiene que sostener ritmo, armonía y detalle solista mientras el fiddle y la segunda voz de Secor le responden en tiempo real. Su historia escribiendo juntos le da al set una gramática musical vivida; no es simplemente juntar a dos nombres fuertes de la música de raíces.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a uno de los cuatro sets si Tokio coincide el 11 o 12 de febrero. El formato íntimo de dúo da una razón fuerte para escoger esa noche, pero las funciones repetidas y la colaboración continua evitan que defina todo el viaje.
